sources.title: Otomata — Batuhan Bozkurt / Earslap
sources.role: Cardinal arrow cells advance, reverse on walls, and turn clockwise on encounters.

transformation: Original visuals and code. Source-derived wall events emit smoothly drifting visible chime pulses. Bounded-speed brass receivers must be struck while a moving pulse centre is physically inside them. Incorrect strikes and escaped pulses are terminal. Independent drift has no short replay period within the episode. No source assets or code copied.
notes: Original Collision Chimes is preserved. Oracle planning is privileged; human usability and agent difficulty remain unmeasured.
